decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical shared DOS symbols and include aggregation.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS, DOS and COMMAND sources include dossym.inc; it in turn includes dbcs.sw, dosmac.inc, version files, buffer.inc, dirent.inc and error.inc.
The previously compared BIOS MSDISK and DOS DIR2 contributions match all 1945 and 1413 target bytes respectively (reviews 012 and 054).
The COMMAND LOADHI comparison matched 1697 non-relocation bytes and 73 internal branches at an inferred target location (review 128).
limitations: The file aggregates independently tracked dependencies: retaining its text does not prove those dependencies or all conditional configurations. VERSIONA, VERSION and final links require their own sequential review and verification.
